text: 金十数据7月19日讯，据长鑫科技公告，公司首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市网下初步配售结果及网上中签结果已公布。本次发行价格8.66元/股，初始发行股份数量约66.88亿股，中签号码共有7,702,207个，每个中签号码只能认购500股长鑫科技A股股票。
text_en: Jinshi Data July 19 - According to an announcement from ChangXin Memory Technologies, the results of the initial offline placement and online lottery for its initial public offering on the STAR Market have been published. The issuance price is 8.66 yuan per share, with an initial offering of approximately 6.688 billion shares. There were 7,702,207 winning lottery numbers, each entitling the holder to subscribe to 500 shares of ChangXin Memory Technologies A-shares.
